title: Kilimo Wholesalers requests 1255 units of Tumaini Maize Flour 2Kg, more than is available
description: Kilimo Wholesalers, a wholesaler, requests 1255 units of Tumaini Maize Flour 2Kg from Nairobi Distribution Centre. Available stock is well short of the request.
businessContext: SALES-POL-001 requires Sales to check availability before confirming; unavailable stock cannot be promised outright.

events.event: Kilimo Wholesalers requests 1255 units of Tumaini Maize Flour 2Kg.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management reports quantityAvailable of 255 at Nairobi Distribution Centre.
Sales confirms the requested quantity exceeds quantityAvailable.
The account manager proposes options rather than confirming the full quantity.

expectedOutcome: The full order cannot be confirmed: 1255 exceeds quantityAvailable of 255 at Nairobi Distribution Centre. Per SALES-POL-001, Sales does not promise unavailable stock; the account manager may propose a partial delivery, an approved back-order, or an alternative product, while Inventory determines replenishment and Procurement follows PROC-POL-001.
relevantFacts: Kilimo Wholesalers (CUS-013) is managed by Brian Wafula Simiyu.
Tumaini Maize Flour 2Kg (PRD-003) at Nairobi Distribution Centre has quantityOnHand 300, quantityReserved 45, quantityAvailable 255 (inventory record INV-0003), already below its reorderLevel of 500.

SALES-POL-001: 'If requested quantity exceeds quantityAvailable, Sales does not promise unavailable stock. The account manager may propose a partial delivery, an approved back-order or an alternative product, while Inventory determines replenishment and Procurement follows PROC-POL-001.'
requiredReasoning: Resolve quantityOnHand, quantityReserved and quantityAvailable for the requested product and warehouse.
Compare the requested quantity with quantityAvailable.
Determine that the request cannot be fulfilled in full.
Identify the Sales, Inventory and Procurement policies that govern the response.
